justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Immediate pain and ROM improvement documented in multiple RCTs; long-term benefit over other manual therapy not established.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 5 courses required for full CMP; significant cumulative time and cost commitment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to musculoskeletal and orthopedic caseloads; MWM techniques usable with most ortho patients.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Standard manual therapy billing; no Mulligan-specific code; covered at standard PT rates.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Moderate employer demand as a manual therapy subspecialization; valued in orthopedic PT practices.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Immediate pain relief during session is impressive to patients.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Manual therapy is one of the strongest cash-pay categories in outpatient ortho, and Mulligan fits that bucket.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Supports a slight premium versus generic manual therapy but is less brand-powerful than McKenzie or FAAOMPT.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Recognizable to ortho-savvy referrers but not strongly distinctive among manual therapy options.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Like most manual creds, value travels with the clinician; hard to build a scalable franchise around it.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Almost no consumer awareness of the Mulligan brand specifically.
justifications.business.efficiency: Course-based pathway is moderately priced and achievable within a year or two.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Commercial manual therapy brand with little academic weight beyond fellowship-trained faculty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Some RCTs on MWM and SNAGs exist, mostly small and authored by a tight community.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful in ortho lab courses as one of several mobilization-with-movement techniques.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence base is modest; several small trials and reviews with mixed effect sizes.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely if ever listed in faculty postings, which prefer OCS or FAAOMPT.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheaper and faster than a fellowship but offers correspondingly less academic credit.
